result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your CT scan was on 10 September 2026. It showed a small spot on your right lung (a nodule). The spot measures 4 mm. It is very small. Most nodules of this size are not cancer.

## What you need to do
1. Wait for the hospital to send you an appointment.
2. Go to the appointment for a repeat CT scan in 12 months.

The hospital wants to check that the nodule has not changed.

## Dates and medicines
- CT scan that showed the nodule: 10 September 2026.
- Repeat CT scan: in 12 months. The exact date is not given yet. The hospital will send it to you.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What is a nodule?
- What does 4 mm mean?
- When will I get my appointment for the repeat CT scan?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
